sloka: राघवः सन्निवेश्यैव सैन्यं स्वं रक्षसां वधे ।सम्मन्त्र्य मन्त्रिभिः सार्धं निश्चित्य च पुनःपुनः ।आनन्तर्यमभिप्रेप्सुः क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् ।। ६.४१.५८ ।।।।
transliteration: rāghavaḥ sanniveśyaiva sainyaṁ svaṁ rakṣasāṁ vadhe ।sammantrya mantribhiḥ sārdhaṁ niścitya ca punaḥpunaḥ ।ānantaryamabhiprepsuḥ kramayogārthatattvavit ।। 6.41.58 ।।।।

translations.english: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.
